repos_data.description: Provides a simple API to fluently map POCO properties to database columns when using Dapper.
Fast DB-independent DAL for .NET Core:  abstract queries, SQL commands builder, schema-less data access, POCO mapping (micro-ORM).

repo_meta_data.description: Simple microORM that maps the results of a query onto a POCO object. Project based on Schotime's branch of PetaPoco
